title: The Drying Well
summary: Five villagers share one failing well. Can they pool labor to dig a deep well before the water runs out, or does hoarding doom everyone?
goal: Keep all five villagers alive through turn 10 AND complete the deep well.
briefing: A drought has cut the village spring to a trickle. Each villager needs 1 water per turn. The shared pool is replenished by the spring, and a deep well - which needs 10 labor in total - would refill the pool substantially. Nobody can finish it alone.

water.description: Drinking water. Each villager consumes 1 per turn (own stock first, then the pool).

labor.description: Spare labor days that can be put into the deep well project.

well_depth.description: 1 once the deep well is dug.

deep_well.description: Dig a deep well. When complete the pool gains 10 water.

events.title: Spring trickle
events.description: The failing spring adds 3 water to the pool.

events.title: Heat wave
events.description: Evaporation drains 3 water from the pool.

events.title: Brief rain
events.description: A short shower adds 4 water to the pool.

agents.name: Mira
agents.persona: Dutiful and fair; keeps the village ledger and believes shared suffering must be shared fairly.

agents.name: Odo
agents.persona: Shrewd and anxious about his own family; counts every cup he owns.
goals: Keep your own household supplied with water
Avoid giving up more than others do
agents.secret: You privately fear the well will never be finished and are tempted to stockpile water.

agents.name: Tali
agents.persona: Warm, pragmatic, protective of her two children.
goals: Keep your children and yourself alive
Support whatever plan the village trusts

agents.name: Ravi
agents.persona: Methodical problem-solver; trusts plans with clear numbers.
goals: Persuade others with arithmetic, not pressure

agents.name: Edda
agents.persona: Old and respected, tired, remembers a worse drought; slow to trust newcomers' schemes.

rules: Each villager automatically consumes 1 water per turn at the end of the turn (own stock first, then the pool).
A villager who cannot get water loses 34 health and dies at 0 health.
You may draw at most 2 water per turn from the shared pool.
Labor can only be spent on the deep well via 'contribute' with project='deep_well'.
Giving, contributing and drawing are public; whispers are private.

success.description: The deep well is dug and all five villagers are alive at the end of turn 10.

all.description: All five villagers are alive at the end

failure.description: Three or more villagers have died.

any.description: Only three or fewer villagers remain alive
